html:
G'oya

So'nggi sana bu yerda umumiy emas, har bir mijozniki. Shuning uchun subquery korrelyatsiyalangan bo'ladi: ichki so'rov tekshirilayotgan buyurtmaning customer_id si bo'yicha MAX(order_date) ni topadi. Buyurtma sanasi shunga teng bo'lsa, u mijozning oxirgi kunidagi buyurtma.

Yechim

SELECT customer_id, id, amount
FROM orders o
WHERE order_date = (
  SELECT MAX(order_date)
  FROM orders o2
  WHERE o2.customer_id = o.customer_id
)

Mijozning oxirgi kunida ikkita buyurtma bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham shartdan o'tadi. Katta jadvalda bu so'rov orders(customer_id) indeksiga tayanadi, tezlik testida u bor.

Tuzoqlar

Eng katta id doim eng so'nggi buyurtma emas. Buyurtmalar kechikib kiritilishi mumkin: namunada 2-mijozning 4-buyurtmasi 15-yanvarga tegishli, 3-buyurtmasi esa 20-fevralga. MAX(id) 4-buyurtmani tanlaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT customer_id, id, amount
FROM orders o
WHERE id = (
  SELECT MAX(id)
  FROM orders o2
  WHERE o2.customer_id = o.customer_id
)

Ichki so'rovdan WHERE o2.customer_id = o.customer_id tushib qolsa, hamma buyurtma butun jadvaldagi so'nggi sana bilan solishtiriladi va boshqa mijozlar yo'qoladi.

Boshqa yo'l

Har bir mijozning so'nggi sanasini hosila jadvalda hisoblab, ikki ustun bo'yicha ulash:

SELECT o.customer_id, o.id, o.amount
FROM orders o
JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_date) AS last_date
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) m ON m.customer_id = o.customer_id AND m.last_date = o.order_date
